description: This file defines the CustomerService class in the OrangeHRM Time plugin, providing methods to interact with Customer entities via a DAO, including searching, counting, and retrieving customers by ID.

classes.name: CustomerService
classes.description: Service class providing customer-related operations such as search, count, and retrieval, encapsulating data access logic.

methods.name: getCustomerDao
methods.description: Lazy initializer for the CustomerDao object, returns the existing instance or creates a new one.

methods.name: setCustomerDao
methods.description: Sets the CustomerDao instance to be used by this service.

methods.name: searchCustomers
methods.description: Performs a search for customers based on filter parameters, returning a list of Customer entities.

methods.name: getCustomersCount
methods.description: Returns the count of customers matching filter parameters.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a Customer entity by its ID.
